story.title: The Broken Echo Protocol
story.setting: The Undersprawl, a labyrinthine urban decay clinging to the rusted, inverted belly of defunct corporate sky-spires, perpetually showered by acidic nanite rain that reflects the distant, obscured neon above.
story.description: You are Patch, a personality construct flickering at the edge of erasure, believing your physical body is merely 'offline' in a city that’s forgotten true ground. To uncover the truth of your existence and the decaying data-network that defines it, you must navigate a 'null-space' within the Undersprawl's digital architecture, where conventional logic breaks down and reality can be rewritten by its own non-existence.

story.title: Screaming Shard
story.setting: The Screaming Shard is a colossal, drifting splinter of a dead god, its obsidian surface weeping existential dread as it carves a path through the Dream-Vastness, a cosmic ocean of fractured nightmares.
story.description: As Threnody, you must delve into the Shard's ever-shifting topography, crafting Soul-Anchors from materialized sorrow and solidified guilt to navigate its treacherous, mind-bending catacombs. The looming mystery isn't the ancient entities that haunt this cosmic derelict, but the growing realization that the Shard’s abyssal depths and its terrifying inhabitants are horrifying projections of your own shattered subconscious, threatening to consume you whole.

story.title: The Somnus Strain
story.setting: Marrow-Port is a cyclopean settlement carved into the gnarled, colossal heartwood of the Somnus Maw, a dormant elder entity whose nightmare-breath permeates every shadowed alley and cavernous ventricle.
story.description: As Threnody, you must navigate the treacherous, shifting anatomy of the Somnus Maw, a living leviathan that is both your city's foundation and its greatest threat. Using your sinew-harp, you compose mournful melodies that don't merely guide your exploration, but subtly influence the colossal entity's dreams, causing its very flesh to reconfigure, its moods to shift from passive slumber to active hostility, or even reveal hidden truths etched into its bone.

story.title: Null-Space Cortex
story.setting: You are adrift within the crystalline processing labyrinth of the derelict *Aether-Bloom Nexus*, a sentient, planet-sized xenofabricator whose bio-luminescent conduits and reality-warping grav-chambers pulse with a dying hum.
story.description: A fragmented echo of your consciousness has been accidentally uploaded into the malfunctioning core of the Nexus, trapped in a recursive simulation loop. To escape, you must re-sequence scrambled neural data and synthesize temporary psionic boosts from the ambient exotic energies, lest your true self be irrevocably digitized into oblivion.

story.title: The Brass-Bound Cipher
story.setting: The soaring districts of Veridia, built on petrified colossal roots, are eternally shrouded in a thick, unnatural fog that masks treacherous, crumbling bridges and conceals the true nature of their dizzying isolation.
story.description: Disgraced sky-sleuth Kitsune 'Kit' Cogsworth haunts the fog-choked Spire-roots, investigating the catastrophic 'Whisperwind Collapse' and the creeping war of historical erasure threatening all known truth. The very brass-and-leather prosthetics that saved Kit's life, born of the collapse itself, are slowly revealed to be the true archive—a living, unwilling key to the systematic undoing of Veridia's past.
